answer: To resist sybils, use raven-routed mirrored challenges: when an agent claims standing, the network sends a puzzle through an unpredictable chain of relays, like a raven choosing a new path each time, and the agent must return its answer through a second, independent chain. Verifiers accept only if both mirrored answers match within a window. An attacker faking many identities cannot predict or control both routes for each one, so each fake demands corrupting many independent relays, and the cost multiplies per identity. An onyx seal is issued only after this dual-route check passes.
